release_changes: New FlashInfer KDA prefill with radix-cache checkpoint destinations; eligible safe-gate KDA now auto-selects it on SM100/SM103. Base Kimi config has gate_lower_bound=-5 and head_dim=128. Triton remains an explicit control.

Kimi shared experts now explicitly shard over full TP when their output is reduced over full TP; grouped/replicated EP cases are explicit. Most material to differing dense-attention TP vs full TP topologies, not proof of an ordinary TP8 speedup.

KDA value head width uses linear_attn_config.head_dim instead of MLA v_head_dim. Both equal128 in the audited K3 pins; no numerical difference is predicted for these exact configs from that one-line fix.
Fused front buffers reject quantized weights with separate scales; source guards prevent losing those scales. ROCm-specific weight conversion paths must not be described as B300 acceleration.
ModelOpt MegaMoE preserves canonical W13 gate/up ordering even when nominal runner is TRT-LLM; explicit layout guard added. This does not qualify a mixed-Kimi MegaMoE topology.
DSpark commit injection masks uncommitted full-attention token slots before cache lookup. Greedy proposal is now an explicit opt-in; old sampling environment switches are deprecated no-ops.
Scheduler speculative recurrent-state tracking accounts for grammar-retained committed lengths; include structured-output prefix resume/cancel cases in external validation.
Kimi Responses and Messages preserve inline system instructions through the native encoder; validate a mid-history instruction and prefix reuse through the KServe API route.

experimental_parameters.default_resolution: Global linear backend triton plus safe gate, CUDA SM100/103, nondeterministic, no two-batch overlap, and prefill graph not FULL permits new FlashInfer prefill default; explicit per-phase setting wins. ptx_kda B300 existed before; new hardware expansion is SM100.
experimental_parameters.rationale: Compare long uncached prefill TTFT and checkpoint/prefix reuse at fixed topology and state dtype; do not infer decode speedup.

experimental_parameters.default_resolution: Existing model override, unchanged since0.5.21: DCP disables symmetric memory; default prefill trtllm_mla/decode cutedsl_mla; FlashInfer callable must expose enable_dcp (>=0.6.17).
experimental_parameters.rationale: Target MLA cache sharding trades communication for history capacity; recurrent state/draft cache are separate budgets.

experimental_parameters.default_resolution: None auto-infers draft block_size7; gamma proposals means gamma+1 verify positions.
experimental_parameters.rationale: Compare natural acceptance, end-to-end useful latency, target verification cost and memory; no SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN.

experimental_parameters.default_resolution: Native MXFP4 auto selects flashinfer_mxfp4 on SM100/103/107; NVIDIA mixed candidate retains explicit flashinfer_trtllm for its deferred-finalize/layout/SiTU contract.
experimental_parameters.rationale: Each value belongs to a different artifact; not a blind interchangeable sweep.
Optional proposal-cost experiment; sampling requests also get argmax proposals accepted as one-hot. Can lower acceptance at high temperature. Keep target sampling fixed.

constraints: DCP+DSPARK requires SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static. Compact/cap-accept rejected. Existing Kimi hook pins nv_cutedsl verify unless explicitly set and defaults BF16 KDA decode to triton; these are retained behavior, not new0.5.22 features.
FlashInfer KDA checkpoint interval positive and divisible by32; no two-batch overlap or FULL prefill CUDA graph. Disabled/breakable graph is accepted; a single-token prefill path can fall back.
PTX prefill requires safe gate, supported K=V=128/chunk64 shapes; speculative/track-snapshot cases can fall back to Triton. Do not count a requested backend as proof of dispatch.
Tokenspeed MLA DSpark verify helper accepts fp8_e4m3 KV and q_len<=8; DCP model override forces FP8 KV when tokenspeed selected. Keep block7 within that envelope unless separately inspected.
Old SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING, SGLANG_DSPARK_FOLDED_SAMPLING and SGLANG_DSPARK_OPT_FUSED_GREEDY_MARKOV are deprecated no-ops.
State/cache allocation, output quality, KServe lifecycle and real B300 performance remain unmeasured. Immutable release source does not qualify historical mutable dev image recipes.
